proof_requests: Send clear close-up photos of the gearbox nameplate showing brand/model, ratio, and any serial/part number.
If the electric motor is included: send photos showing the motor nameplate (HP/kW, voltage, RPM) and the motor coupled to the gearbox.
Send a short running video (start + 30–60 seconds) showing smooth operation/no abnormal noise.
Provide a photo of any receipt/documentation or import label (Belgium) if claiming tokunbo/direct import.
